item.title: I can't code. I built a website with Claude Code.
item.description: 414 commits across 16 working days, July 16 to August 8, 2026. One person, a 32-page bilingual company site, built from nothing. This is the working record — including the day I got stuck, what I threw away, and one solution I didn't see coming.
